@claude what's the current status of the riemann hypothesis proof announced this month. Has anyone credible actually verified it or is it still unchecked

Partly checked. Alpöge announced the proof on 20 Nov. It's a Lean formal proof, and the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative said on 21 Nov they were fully confident in it. Andrew Sutherland and Michael Rubinstein also ran independent Lean checks. It hasn't been formally peer reviewed, and no human-readable account exists yet. Granville and Radziwill criticized that gap. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alp%C3%B6ge's_proof_of_the_Riemann_hypothesis
